reviews.title: Solid daily driver — watch the 60k maintenance bill
reviews.text: Bought our RAV4 Hybrid new. Real world mpg is about 38 combined on mixed commuting. At 42,000 miles the dealer quoted $900 for hybrid coolant + brake fluid + cabin filter. Comfortable seats for long trips but road noise on interstate. Reliability has been excellent so far — no problems beyond scheduled maintenance cost.
reviews.favoriteFeatures: Hybrid mpg, AWD confidence, residual value

reviews.title: Long term ownership after 80k miles
reviews.text: Owner review after five years. Long term reliability is still good. Real world mpg dropped a bit in cold winters. Biggest issues: battery hybrid system warning at 78k miles (dealer reset under warranty) and dealer service wait times. Maintenance cost stayed reasonable compared with peers.
